note: This is a separate manual-review ledger. The machine-generated source candidate file remains unchanged and still reports comparisonStatus=not_reviewed; Supported here means source/API mapping only, not visual, runtime, accessibility or parity acceptance.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.rationale: Bluent Text is rendered as the button's content; the pinned tag exposes a default slot.

parameters.name: TextClass
parameters.mapping: Bluent inner text wrapper class; WC exposes CSS part content
parameters.rationale: A per-text class is not equivalent to styling the whole WC content part.

parameters.name: SecondaryText
parameters.rationale: The equivalent concept exists on the separate compound-button tag, not as a property of fluent-button.

parameters.name: Icon
parameters.mapping: fluent-button start slot; end slot for alternate placement
parameters.rationale: The slot can host icon content; Bluent's paired regular/filled icon rendering and state CSS remain Bluent-specific.

parameters.name: Toggled
parameters.rationale: Bluent currently renders a normal button with a toggled class; it does not adopt the toggle-button pressed/mixed or ARIA contract.
parameters.followUp: Verify aria-pressed and state-change behavior in the real browser.

parameters.name: Rotated
parameters.rationale: No rotation attribute or state is documented for the pinned button tags.

parameters.name: Orientation
parameters.rationale: No orientation attribute is documented for the pinned button tags.

parameters.name: ToggledChanged
parameters.mapping: Blazor EventCallback<bool>; no custom event documented in the pinned toggle-button CEM
parameters.rationale: The callback is paired with Bluent's Toggled parameter; a CEM event or runtime-equivalent callback contract is not established.

parameters.name: OnClick
parameters.mapping: Native DOM click event bridged to EventCallback
parameters.rationale: Click is a standard DOM event, not a custom event listed in the CEM; disabled/navigation callback ordering still needs runtime evidence.
parameters.followUp: Verify pointer, keyboard activation, disabled and navigation ordering.

parameters.name: Shape
parameters.rationale: Bluent Rounded/Circular/Square values match the pinned WC shape values.

parameters.name: Appearance
parameters.rationale: Default maps by omitting the attribute; Primary/Outline/Subtle/Transparent match the pinned values. Danger is an extra Bluent appearance.

valueDispositions.mapping: no matching appearance value in the pinned WC CEM

parameters.name: Size
parameters.rationale: Small/Medium/Large match the pinned WC size values.

parameters.name: Href
parameters.rationale: Bluent switches to an anchor when Href is non-empty; this is a related-tag mapping, not a single fluent-button API. Disabled-link semantics are separately audited.
parameters.followUp: Verify href, disabled and keyboard behavior in the real browser.

parameters.name: Badge
parameters.mapping: Positioned nested Badge; no dedicated button badge slot in the pinned CEM
parameters.rationale: The button renders a positioned wrapper around a Badge; the WC button tags do not expose a badge slot or position API.

parameters.name: BadgeHorizontalPosition
parameters.rationale: No horizontal badge-position attribute exists on the pinned WC button tags.

parameters.name: BadgeVerticalPosition
parameters.rationale: No vertical badge-position attribute exists on the pinned WC button tags.

parameters.name: Dropdown
parameters.mapping: Popover/Surface composition; fluent-menu-button is related only
parameters.rationale: The pinned menu-button CEM does not document a dedicated menu/dropdown slot; Bluent composes a Popover and Surface.

parameters.name: ShowDropdownIndicator
parameters.rationale: The indicator is drawn by Bluent Icon instances; no matching WC attribute is documented.

parameters.name: Compact
parameters.rationale: No compact attribute exists on the pinned WC button tags.

parameters.name: DropdownPlacement
parameters.rationale: Dropdown placement belongs to the Bluent Popover composition, not the button tag API.

parameters.name: ParentPopover
parameters.rationale: This is a Blazor composition contract, not a Fluent WC property.

parameters.name: Overflow
parameters.rationale: This is a Blazor overflow composition contract, not a Fluent WC property.

parameters.name: Tooltip
parameters.mapping: BluentUiComponentBase TooltipService; no corresponding WC tooltip API
parameters.rationale: Tooltip is registered against the generated/provided id with mouseenter/focus triggers and mouseleave/blur hides; native title is not equivalent.

parameters.name: TooltipContent
parameters.rationale: Arbitrary tooltip content is a Bluent composition; no tooltip-content slot exists on the referenced WC tags.

parameters.name: TooltipPlacement
parameters.rationale: Placement is configured by the Bluent tooltip service, not by a referenced WC attribute.

parameters.name: TooltipAppearance
parameters.rationale: Popover styling is a Bluent API and has no direct attribute on these WC tags.

parameters.name: DisplayTooltipArrow
parameters.rationale: No matching tooltip component or arrow attribute exists in the pinned WC tag contracts.

parameters.name: AdditionalAttributes
parameters.mapping: Blazor unmatched-attribute bridge to the root HTML element
parameters.rationale: Source forwards arbitrary attributes; exact DOM, disabled and ARIA behavior remains a separate runtime/AT check.
parameters.followUp: Verify forwarded attributes on the real component in both Blazor render modes.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.mapping: HTML class attribute merged with Bluent classes
parameters.rationale: BluentComponentBase.GetComponentClass combines component classes with Class; a CSS part is not a direct replacement for this Blazor API.

parameters.name: Style
parameters.mapping: HTML style attribute on the root element
parameters.rationale: The component forwards Style to the rendered root; CSS token and theme equivalence remain separate review dimensions.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.mapping: IconDefinition source abstraction; Fluent System Icons is asset-level reference only
parameters.rationale: IconDefinition supports CSS-class, arbitrary SVG and image sources; the pinned WC package has no generic Icon tag and the React icon package is not a component-level counterpart.

parameters.name: Variant
parameters.mapping: Fluent System Icons Regular/Filled asset variants
parameters.rationale: IconVariant exposes Regular/Filled and falls back to Regular when Filled is absent. No Color enum exists; exact Color asset coverage and requirement remain undecided.

valueDispositions.mapping: filled asset/source, with Regular fallback when absent
not part of the current public enum; no feature requirement approved

outOfBandPublicApi.name: Id
outOfBandPublicApi.scope: BluentComponentBase public API; not counted among the 82 [Parameter] occurrences
outOfBandPublicApi.mapping: HTML id via AdditionalAttributes; generated identifier when none is supplied
outOfBandPublicApi.rationale: BluentComponentBase reads a caller id from AdditionalAttributes or creates one; TooltipService uses the resulting id.

outOfBandPublicApi.name: Disabled
outOfBandPublicApi.scope: Attribute-based base behavior; not a typed [Parameter]
outOfBandPublicApi.rationale: IsDisabled recognizes only a boolean true value. Link/Button disabled navigation semantics differ from fluent-link/fluent-button and need explicit runtime evidence.

outOfBandPublicApi.name: SetStateHasChanged
outOfBandPublicApi.scope: IBluentComponent/Blazor base method; not a component property

outOfBandPublicApi.name: IconVariant.Color
outOfBandPublicApi.scope: Potential future icon feature; not in current public enum
outOfBandPublicApi.mapping: No Color enum in the current Bluent IconVariant; do not add one without exact asset-release coverage, license/shipping, theme/forced-colors and design review.
outOfBandPublicApi.rationale: The pinned React icon package is an asset reference, not a generic Icon component; the local 20px font map has no Color entries.
